description: This is a Java test class that tests the SubjectsModifiedStrategy in the context of policy event handling within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifically focuses on creating a new Label with associated Subjects and verifying the policy modifications.

classes.name: SubjectsModifiedStrategyCreateTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending AbstractPolicyEventStrategyTest to validate behavior of SubjectsModifiedStrategy when a new label with subjects is created within a policy.

methods.name: getStrategyUnderTest
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SubjectsModifiedStrategy to be tested.

methods.name: getPolicyEvent
methods.description: Constructs and returns a SubjectsModified event with specified instant and policy context.

methods.name: additionalAssertions
methods.description: Performs assertions on the policy after applying the event, verifying existing labels remain untouched, and the new label with subjects has been correctly added.
